items.q: What is Bonddy and how does it work?
items.a: Bonddy connects you with local buddies to design a personalized itinerary, quick advice, and support during your trip.

items.q: Can I request a trip based on my interests?
items.a: Yes. Share your interests, timing, and budget and we will suggest a tailored plan.

items.q: Is the service suitable for families or couples?
items.a: Absolutely. We optimize itineraries for different group sizes and needs.
